item.title: Real Wedding: Maria and Bates' Hometown Destination Wedding in Memphis
item.description: An unmistakable energy fueled Maria and Bates' wedding celebration in the bride's hometown of Memphis, Tennessee. After a chance meeting and building a life together that's carried them from Boston to Berlin, a destination wedding in Maria's hometown felt both deeply rooted in the past and joyfully expansive of their future. item.title: What You Need to Tell Your Wedding Photographer After You Hire Them
item.description: Photo: Melani Lust Photography Your photographer will guide you through plenty, but there are a few key things only you can share. Here’s the context you can give them early to help the entire day run more smoothly."Couples should talk through the full flow of their wedding day with their photographer, especially how many locations are involved.
